flags.why: The common colloquial meaning 'afraid of; daunted by' is missing, as in 'chẳng ngán ai' ([dictionary](https://v2.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Ng%C3%A1n)).
flags.fix: Add: [colloquial] afraid of; daunted by. Example: Anh ấy chẳng ngán ai. = He isn't afraid of anyone.

flags.why: This elevated word for escorting and protecting needs a register warning to prevent casual use.
